label: Plotting points from pairs
subgoals: Step right for positive x and left for negative x
Step up for positive y and down for negative y

slice.rule: To plot $(x, y)$, step $x$ blocks right if $x$ is positive and left if it is negative, then step $y$ blocks up if $y$ is positive and down if it is negative. Horizontal first, then vertical, every time.

label: Quadrants and axis points
subgoals: Sort sign pairs into quadrants I through IV
Name all seven special places: origin, axes, quadrants

slice.rule: Signs place the quadrant: $(+,+)$ is I, $(-,+)$ is II, $(-,-)$ is III, $(+,-)$ is IV. A zero coordinate puts the point on an axis instead of in any quadrant, and two zeros put it at the origin.
slice.note: A point with one zero coordinate has no quadrant. That is the case most often mislabelled.

label: Drill: plot (3, 2), (-5, -1), (0, -3), (4, 0)
subgoals: Walk each pair horizontal-first, then vertical
Land (-5, -1) two signs deep in Quadrant III
Rest every point with a zero on its axis

slice.rule: Plot each pair and name where it lands. Checking the sign pattern before drawing catches most errors.
